name: The Burren
story: The Burren is a rocky landscape centered in County Clare on the west coast of Ireland, covering around 530 square kilometres. It features exposed limestone pavement and supports diverse plant growth due to a long growing season. Traditional strongholds for the European pine marten include the Burren.
matters: The region supports rich plant growth such as the mountain avens. It serves as a traditional stronghold for the European pine marten, whose recovering population helps native red squirrels by preying on invasive grey squirrels.
